title: Ceasefire takes effect in Gaza and Hamas frees its first three hostages
body:
The Gaza ceasefire took effect on 19 January 2025, although it had been scheduled to begin at 8:30 a.m. Israel said Hamas had not provided the names of the three hostages due for release, and Israeli strikes that morning killed 19 people. Hamas said the delay was due to technical field reasons.

Later on 19 January, Hamas handed three female hostages to the Red Cross: Emily Damari, Romi Gonen and Doron Steinbrecher. They were the first of the 33 Israeli captives that Hamas was to release in the first phase, in exchange for up to 1,904 Palestinian security prisoners, including 737 serving life terms. On 20 January Israel released 69 women and 21 children, 90 Palestinians in total.

Israel's security cabinet had approved the deal in an afternoon vote on 17 January, followed by approval from the full cabinet later that day. Israeli strikes on 16 January, before the ceasefire began, killed 86 people.
